summary: Comprehensive Admin Access Control Panel testing completed. All 19 backend API tests PASSED. Frontend UI tests verified: role selector tabs with visible/total counts, 3 module groups (Dashboard with 15 items, Capex Request with 10 items, Analytics with 6 items), item toggles, permission selectors, Show All/Hide All, module toggles, global lock/unlock, Save Changes, and Reset functionality. Dashboard correctly hides/shows cards based on access control settings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Access Control Panel with granular dashboard items fully tested. Structure: 3 modules with 31 total items. Dashboard module has 15 items in 3 groups: KPI Statistics Cards (10 items: card_budget_utilized, card_pending_approvals, card_cost_savings, card_completion_rate, card_dept_requests, card_my_requests, card_completed, card_in_progress, card_my_assigned, card_purchase_value), Analytics Charts (2 items: dept_spend_chart, buyer_performance_chart), Dashboard Widgets (3 items: pending_tasks, recent_requests, cost_savings_widget). Capex Request module has 10 items. Analytics module has 6 items. Role tabs show visible/total counts. Dashboard.jsx uses hasAccess('dashboard', accessId) to filter stat cards per role.
